purpose: Complete Stage 5.12 using materialized functional fragments while preserving NEX-1 v0.1, canonical wire, operational v0.3 carriers, status codes and frozen budgets.
laws: decodeTerm(encodeTerm(term)) == term extensionally on admitted canonical Term values
encodeTerm(decodeTerm(bits)) == canonical(bits) extensionally on successfully decoded canonical wire
function-valued equality forces exact length contents plus the required out-of-range sentinel

algorithmic_successor_intent.problem_in_v0.2: decoded Term remained a random-access view over source wire; distinct token queries reparsed wire, so encodeTerm(decodeTerm(bits)) still exceeded the frozen Python-need transition budget on deepmixed
algorithmic_successor_intent.decode_v0.3: recursively parse once into functional token fragments. Each fragment carries token length, token function and next wire offset; parent token functions compose already-built child fragments rather than reparsing source wire for each index
algorithmic_successor_intent.encode_v0.3: recursively parse Term tokens once into functional bit fragments. Each fragment carries bit length, bit function and next token offset; parent bit functions compose already-built child fragments rather than re-reading the source token stream for each output bit
algorithmic_successor_intent.top_level: validate exact consumption once, then expose the constructed fragment function and length through the unchanged CodecResult interface

candidate_discipline.development_provenance: exact union of v0.2 development and the known/unexecuted v0.2 holdout
candidate_discipline.observation_compaction: four compound success evaluations per valid term preserve status+length+full extensional stream+sentinel assertions; error cases retain one status observation
candidate_discipline.after_first_candidate_execution: any algorithmic or candidate-wire change requires full-codec candidate v0.4 and a new preregistered holdout
candidate_discipline.holdout_rule: v0.3 holdout may execute once only after frozen development success, bounded-exhaustive success, unchanged candidate identity and a green historical checkpoint

required_checks: Direct Go and Direct Python canonical wire agree
NEX decodeTerm returns exact v0.3 tokens
NEX encodeTerm returns exact canonical wire

forbidden_shortcuts: opaque original-wire retention as decoded Term
host callback for constructor or U encoding decisions
host AST/list/byte-array as semantic state inside NEX candidate
dropping or weakening deepmixed or any earlier known case
completion_boundary: Stage 5.13 remains blocked until v0.3 or a later properly preregistered successor passes development, bounded exhaustive, one-shot holdout, final historical regression, diff review and documentation closeout.
